Russia Closes German Consulate in St. Petersburg

Russia has announced the closure of the German consulate in St. Petersburg. This action is a retaliatory measure following Germany's decision last week to close a Russian consulate. Moscow cited a failed drone attack on an airport as the reason for its earlier move. The closure deepens a diplomatic freeze between the two countries.
